subject: general
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.

Both men and women consider a variety of concerns when selecting there outfits.
solution:
The correct answer is "**when selecting there outfits**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• In the given sentence, the error lies in the last segment.
 
• **The word "there" should be replaced with "their" as it is the possessive form of "they".**
 
• **"There" refers to a place (**वहाँ)**, while "their" indicates possession (**उनका).
 
 
• Example: I am always there for you. 
 
• Their car is red in color.
 
 
 
• This is a common mistake made in English language usage.
 
• The correct sentence should read: "Both men and women consider a variety of concerns when selecting their outfits__."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.
